items.title: Vince Giordano interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: he played the J.C. Johnson tune called “Traveling All Alone.”

ctx.x: But the melodies he came up with just somehow seemed to disconnect to the kind of person you would think he was unless you got to really know him.

Yeah. Oh he was definitely in another world when he played and that was the true spirit and genius of the guy through that. We did one performance backing him up at Dick Wellstood’s funeral and he played the J.C. Johnson tune called “Traveling All Alone.” And even now it still grabs me, just thinking about it, and the hair on the back of my neck —
Well I got to play with him a couple of times up at Hamilton College and I’m telling you it was a high point of my life just about. I brought in a little, this will be like a drop the needle test.
